question: If (P/2) = (Q/5) = (R/6), then what is the value of P² ∶ (P + Q)² ∶ (Q + R)²
solution:
**Given:**

(P/2) = (Q/5) = (R/6)

**Calculation:**

Let, (P/2) = (Q/5) = (R/6) = k

So, P = 2k ,Q = 5k and R = 6k

By putting the value of P,Q and R we get,

⇒ P2 ∶ (P + Q)2 ∶ (Q + R)2

⇒ (2k)²: (2k + 5k)²): (5k + 6k)²

⇒ 4k²: 49k² : 121k²

⇒ 4: 49 : 121

47
